case: The contradiction of premise-held, a custody seal taken while it held; then question 2's answer recorded again naming the finding that rebuts P-1. Question 1's answer still assumes P-1.
design: docs/adr/0011 'Premises': premise_inconsistent holds while standing answers assume and contradict the same premise revision over scopes that overlap; the ways out are all on the record and none forces either side: revise an answer, name the rebutting finding (the premise goes to the operator as a dispute, a request of kind premise), narrow a scope, or answer conditionally. Uncertainty alone holds nothing.

docs/adr/0011 'Premises': the answer that assumes a premise another answer rebuts on a standing finding is warned (premise_disputed); nothing is forced on it, and the ruling on the premise is the operator's.
docs/adr/0011 'Consequences': premises ride the question chain, so custody seals them and an earlier seal verifies as a prefix of the chain that grew after it.
docs/adr/0013 'The end of a run, under every stop policy': done finishes a run when every question has a disposition under the bar; a warning never holds.
